Edit target: the attached approved.png. This is an existing rigid carved marble sculpture; preserve its identity, anatomy, silhouette and exact world-space pose.

No added base, pedestal, platform, scenery, fog, glow, cast shadow, text, or watermark. True transparent alpha background, clean antialiased neutral marble edges. Do not mirror, re-pose, restyle, add limbs, shorten limbs, change finger count, or reinterpret fabric. One image only.
